standard.summary: LoRA/模型权重保存时的数值精度。FP16 文件最小，FP32 精度最高。
standard.effect: fp16 文件约为 fp32 的一半大小；bf16 和 fp16 文件大小相近但数值范围不同。
standard.whenToUse: fp16 是最常见的选择，文件大小和推理精度平衡良好。
standard.avoidWhen: 如果后续要 merge/继续训练，保存 fp32 或 float 避免精度累积损失。

optionDescriptions.bf16: 存成 bf16，体积跟 fp16 差不多。
optionDescriptions.auto: 不指定,交给运行时按训练精度与量化配置决定落盘精度;显式值解析不了时也会落回这里。

standard_en.summary: The numeric precision the LoRA/model weights are saved at. FP16 gives the smallest file, FP32 the highest precision.
standard_en.effect: An fp16 file is about half the size of fp32; bf16 and fp16 files are similar in size but differ in numeric range.
standard_en.whenToUse: fp16 is the most common choice, balancing file size against inference precision well.
standard_en.avoidWhen: If you will merge or continue training later, save fp32 or float to avoid accumulating precision loss.

optionDescriptions.fp16: Saved as fp16, for a slightly smaller file.
optionDescriptions.float: Saved as fp32, the largest and fattest.
optionDescriptions.bf16: Saved as bf16, about the same size as fp16.
optionDescriptions.auto: Unspecified: the runtime decides the on-disk precision from the training precision and the quantization configuration; an explicit value that cannot be parsed also falls back here.

advanced.principle: 训练过程中权重保持 FP32 主副本（mixed_precision 下）。保存时将 FP32 权重 cast 到目标精度。fp16 有 5 位指数 + 10 位尾数，bf16 有 8 位指数 + 7 位尾数。
advanced.intervention: 在 save_pretrained / safetensors 保存时转换 dtype。
advanced.expectedImpact: fp16/bf16 保存对推理质量影响极小（<0.1%），但文件体积减半。
advanced.tradeoffs: mem_efficient_save 在保存前将 tensor 移到 CPU，减少保存时的 GPU 显存峰值。

advanced_en.principle: During training, weights keep an FP32 master copy (under mixed_precision). At save time the FP32 weights are cast to the target precision. fp16 has 5 exponent bits + 10 mantissa bits; bf16 has 8 exponent bits + 7 mantissa bits.
advanced_en.intervention: Converts dtype during save_pretrained / safetensors saving.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: fp16/bf16 saving has a minimal effect on inference quality (<0.1%) but halves file size.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: mem_efficient_save moves tensors to CPU before saving, reducing the GPU VRAM peak during saving.
